table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end, 
	altersaleinvcode=max(saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
	users.username,  
	salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	custref=max(saleledger.custrefno),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	gcode=max(dbo.saledetail.gcode), 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	itemgstperc=MAX(saledetail.gstperc),
	SalesTaxSchedule_prec = (SELECT MAX(STS.taxperc) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	TaxType = (SELECT MAX(STS.TaxType) FROM SalesTaxSchedule STS WHERE STS.SalesTaxScheduleCode = Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode),
	itemunitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
	discperc  = max(case when saledetail.discperc > 0 then saledetail.discperc else saledetail.clonediscperc end), 
	clonediscperc=saledetail.clonediscperc,
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc = max(case when saledetail.itemflatdisc > 0 then saledetail.itemflatdisc else saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc end), 
	cloneitemflatdisc=saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc,
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	totaltaxonInv=dbo.fn_gettaxonsaleinv(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	fiscalinvoiceno = saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
	fbrposfee=max(saleledger.fbrposfee),
	cashtendered=max(saleledger.cashtendered),
	cashcharged=max(saleledger.cashcharged),
	CardCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=:ra_InvCode),0),
	InvTotal= max(saleledger.invtotal)
FROM dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno,
			saledetail.icode, 
			saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.clonediscperc,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			item.customicode,
			Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
			users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum(looseqty * if(itemunitsalestax > 0, if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', (saledetail_rate - itemunitsalestax), saledetail_saleprice) , saledetail_saleprice ) for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)

objects.name: compute_20
objects.expression: sum(looseqty * if(itemunitsalestax > 0, if(taxtype='D' OR taxtype='E' or TaxType='I', (saledetail_rate - itemunitsalestax), saledetail_saleprice) , saledetail_saleprice ) for all) + totaltaxoninv

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Sum ((looseqty * (saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, itemflatdisc)))  *  ( 1 -  ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01)) for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc  * .01)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: if(cashtendered - cashcharged - cardcharged  > 0, cashtendered - cashcharged - cardcharged ,  if( cashcharged + cardcharged > 0,  (cashcharged + cardcharged),  cashreceived) -(invtotal ))

objects.name: c_totaldiscval
objects.expression: SUM((looseqty * itemflatdisc) + (looseqty * ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E' or TaxType='I', saledetail_rate, saledetail_saleprice) - itemflatdisc) * (saledetail_discperc * 0.01)) for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + Sum ((looseqty * (saledetail_saleprice - if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, itemflatdisc)))  *  ( 1 -  ( if(taxtype='D' or TaxType='E', 0, saledetail_discperc) * 0.01)) for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc  * .01)

objects.name: t_7
objects.text: if(fbrposfee > 0 and fbrposfee = saleledger_misccharges , 'POS Service Fee:', 'Misc. Charges:')

objects.name: compute_19
objects.expression: if(fbrposfee > 0 and fbrposfee = saleledger_misccharges , fbrposfee, saleledger_misccharges)

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice)+ round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: saledetail_saleprice + ROUND(((Round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)) / if(looseqty > 0, looseqty, 1)),2)

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: ROUND(((Round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)) / if(looseqty > 0, looseqty, 1)),2)
